item.title: Weak-Solvating Carboxylate Ester Electrolyte Enables Hybrid Interphase via Cooperative Additives toward Wide-Temperature Sodium Metal Batteries
item.description:

ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in combining methyl propanoate with VC/NaDFOB additives to synergistically tune Na+ solvation and build a robust hybrid organic-inorganic interphase. This enables fast ion transport and stable interfaces across wide temperatures, achieving 2.52 mS cm–1 at –40 °C and 900+ cycles at –20 °C, offering a practical strategy for wide-temperature sodium metal batteries.
🏷 sodium metal battery · weak-solvating electrolyte · methyl propanoate · hybrid interphase · wide temperature

item.title: Quantifying Sodium Metal SEI Dissolution and Relation to Corrosion Using Quartz Crystal Microbalance
item.description:
با میکروبالانس کریستال کوارتز نشان داده شد که ۵۵ تا ۷۶٪ از SEI اولیه در NaPF6/diglyme حل می‌شود و این ناپایداری باعث خوردگی پیوسته سدیم در پیری تقویمی می‌گردد.
ACS Energy Letters | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in quantitatively measuring SEI mass formation and dissolution for NaPF6 in diglyme using quartz crystal microbalance, revealing 55–76% SEI dissolution at varying potentials. Significance: inorganic salts (NaF, NaxPOyFz) are unstable during open-circuit rest, causing continuous sodium corrosion during calendar aging—highlighting a key stability concern for ether-based sodium-metal batteries.
🏷 sodium metal battery · SEI dissolution · quartz crystal microbalance · calendar aging · ether electrolyte

item.title: LiTFSI‐Regulated Free‐Standing Conductive Polymer Hydrogels for Flexible Supercapacitors
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in using LiTFSI as an ionic modulator to tune PEDOT chain conformation and nanoscale organization within a free-standing PAAm/PVA double-network hydrogel, simultaneously boosting conductivity (28.4 S cm⁻¹), capacitance (202.5 F g⁻¹), stretchability (~506%), and anti-freezing performance (−40°C). This mild, scalable strategy enables durable all-hydrogel supercapacitors with 98.8% retention over 10,000 cycles for wearable energy storage.

item.title: Dynamic Solvation Perturbation Enables Fast‐Exchange Interfacial Water Regulation for Stable Aqueous Zinc Batteries
item.description:

Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a dynamic solvation perturbation strategy using methyl acetate to create a fast-exchange mixed solvation sheath, shortening water residence time and passivating residual water—unlike static coordination-number approaches. Its significance: facet-selective adsorption suppresses water attack, enabling over 8000 h Zn cycling, stable 80% DOD operation, and practical pouch-cell performance.
